summary: First-run full backend + frontend test of PrakritiDx. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering health, quiz (skin/hair prompt interpolation), quiz submit (single & dual-dosha computation, 400 on <6 answers), ingredients (skin/vata, hair/kapha), results retrieval, AI recommendations (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations — first call ~30s generated valid JSON with summary/routine/key_ingredients/avoid/do/dont/herbs; second identical call served from MongoDB cache in <1s), and dosha meta. Frontend (mobile viewport 420x900): landing shows PrakritiDx wordmark + 'Know Your Constitution' tagline, sage-green sliding pill toggle animates between Skin/Hair with correct copy + hero swap, quiz loads 12 questions with 'skin'/'hair' surface interpolation, auto-advances after ~220ms on choice, back/exit buttons work, Q12 shows 'Reveal my Prakriti', submit navigates to Results with correct Vata label + score bars (12·100% / 0% / 0%) + tagline, 'See my personalized routine' loads AI content with all sections (rec-summary, routine-step-0..N with Morning/Evening/Weekly icons, ingredient-*, do-list, dont-list, avoid-*, herb-*, library-*), and per-category state persists independently via localStorage (switching to Hair from Skin/Recommendations shows a fresh Hair landing while switching back to Skin restores the Recommendations screen).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_dosha considers 'dual dosha' when secondary is within 2 of primary AND >0 — with 12 identical-primary answers (like 12·vata) this correctly stays single-dosha (secondary score 0). Good.
GET /api/results/{session_id} returns all quiz history including full answers[] array; consider paginating or trimming answers if history grows.
Recommendation cache key includes secondary_dosha=None which is fine, but consider indexing (session_id, category, primary_dosha, secondary_dosha) on db.recommendations for scale.

Frontend App.js persists {stage, result} in localStorage per-category key correctly, but the stage 'recommendations' persists even after browser refresh which will refetch the (cached) AI content — acceptable and expected.
DoshaFlow choose() auto-advances via setTimeout but does not clear the timeout on unmount — negligible risk since idx state guard prevents overflow.
No data-testid on 'view-result-btn' shown only when a saved result exists; already covered — good.
Consider adding an aria-live region on Recommendations loading state for accessibility.
test_credentials: N/A — no user auth; anonymous session_id from localStorage.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with 'TEST-' session_id was written to MongoDB collections quiz_results and recommendations. Cleanup not required for this run but noted for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (from /app/frontend/.env). Recommendation endpoint first-call latency ~15-40s (AI); subsequent identical calls (same session_id+category+primary+secondary) return from cache. Frontend is mobile-first (max-w-md); use 420x900 viewport. Use data-testid selectors listed in review_request. State persistence is per-category via localStorage keys prakritidx:state:skin and prakritidx:state:hair.
rca of the issue: No issues to root-cause. All specified features work end-to-end.
